name: web-industrial-mobile-home-standing-on-wooden-shelf-in-sunlight
title: Metal-supplier mobile homepage on a phone standing on a wooden shelf against dappled beige light
whatItIs: A phone stands upright on the edge of a wooden shelf against a beige wall with soft leaf shadows and a wooden chair back, in a rounded frame. The screen shows a blue hero with metal profiles and offer cards.
whatItMeans: Warm and natural; wood and light soften an industrial catalogue.
techniques: Stand the phone on a shelf edge.

vocabulary.definition: A device standing at a shelf edge.
